datasets.name: shelf_metrics
queryLines:
-- ============================================================
-- STEP 1: Filter spine
-- Apply ALL dashboard filters here and nowhere else.
-- This gives us the exact set of primary keys that survive
-- the current filter state.
-- ============================================================
WITH filtered_spine AS (
  SELECT
  f.*
  FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.gold.facing') AS f
  LEFT JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.gold.catalog') AS c
  ON f.catalog_uuid = c.catalog_uuid
  LEFT JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.gold.subsection') AS t
  ON t.subsection_uuid = f.subsection_uuid
  LEFT JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.gold.promo') AS p
  ON p.catalog_uuid = f.catalog_uuid AND p.price_uuid = f.price_uuid
  -- ── All dashboard filter parameters go here ──────────────
  WHERE 1=1
    AND (:brand_filter        = 'All' OR c.catalog_brand       = :brand_filter)
    AND (:container_type_filter        = 'All' OR c.catalog_container_type       = :container_type_filter)
    AND (:product_name_filter = 'All' OR c.catalog_name = :product_name_filter)
    AND (:subsection_name_filter    = 'All' OR t.subsection_name   = :subsection_name_filter)
    AND (:subsection_type_filter    = 'All' OR t.subsection_type   = :subsection_type_filter)
    AND (:store_filter    = 'All' OR t.store_name  = :store_filter)
    AND f.result_dt_created >= :visit_date_from
    AND f.result_dt_created <= :visit_date_to
    AND (__aibi_external_value IS NULL OR CONCAT(:catalog,'') = 'demo_production' OR __aibi_external_value IN (SELECT comment FROM system.information_schema.catalogs WHERE catalog_name LIKE CONCAT(:catalog,'')))
),

-- ============================================================
-- STEP 2: Shelf metrics
-- Count at shelf grain using only filtered rows.
-- ============================================================
shelf_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    s.*
  FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.gold.shelf') s
  WHERE (s.result_uuid, s.realogram_item_shelf_id) IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT result_uuid, realogram_item_shelf_id FROM filtered_spine
  )    
  AND s.result_dt_created >= :visit_date_from
  AND s.result_dt_created <= :visit_date_to
),

-- ============================================================
-- STEP 3: Catalog metrics (RRP grain = catalog_uuid)
-- Only aggregate catalogs that appear in the filtered spine.
-- SUM here is safe — one row per catalog_uuid in catalog table.
-- ============================================================
catalog_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.*
  FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.gold.catalog') AS c
  WHERE c.catalog_uuid IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT catalog_uuid FROM filtered_spine
  )
),

-- ============================================================
-- STEP 4: Subsection metrics (subsection grain = subsection_uuid)
-- Only aggregate subsections that appear in the filtered spine.
-- ============================================================
subsection_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    o.*
  FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.gold.subsection') AS o
  WHERE o.subsection_uuid IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT subsection_uuid FROM filtered_spine
  )
),

-- ============================================================
-- STEP 5: Image metrics (grain = catalog_uuid + result_uuid)
-- Only aggregate image rows present in filtered spine.
-- ============================================================
image_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    i.*
  FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.gold.image') AS i
  WHERE (i.catalog_uuid, i.result_uuid, i.roi_id) IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT catalog_uuid, result_uuid, roi_id FROM filtered_spine
  )
  AND i.result_dt_created >= :visit_date_from
  AND i.result_dt_created <= :visit_date_to
),

-- ============================================================
-- STEP 6: Promo metrics (grain = catalog_uuid + subsection_uuid + price_uuid)
-- Only aggregate promos present in filtered spine.
-- ============================================================
promo_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    p.*
  FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.gold.promo') AS p
  WHERE (p.catalog_uuid, p.price_uuid) IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT catalog_uuid, price_uuid FROM filtered_spine
  )
)

-- ============================================================
-- STEP 7: Final join
-- All CTEs are already aggregated at their correct grain.
-- No fan-out possible — every join is now many-to-one or one-to-one.
-- ============================================================
SELECT
  -- dimensions for grouping / filtering in dashboard
  fs.*,
  "" AS one,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fs.catalog_uuid ORDER BY 1)=1 AS catalog_once,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fs.subsection_uuid ORDER BY 1)=1 AS subsection_once,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fs.result_uuid,fs.catalog_uuid,fs.roi_id ORDER BY 1)=1 AS image_once,
  CASE WHEN fs.catalog_uuid='Unknown' OR fs.price_uuid='Unknown' THEN 1=1 ELSE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fs.catalog_uuid,fs.price_uuid ORDER BY 1)=1 END AS promo_once,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fs.result_uuid,fs.realogram_item_shelf_id ORDER BY 1)=1 AS shelf_once,

  -- shelf grain measures
  sm.* EXCEPT (result_uuid,realogram_item_shelf_id,result_dt_created),

  -- catalog grain measures (safe — pre-aggregated at catalog_uuid)
  cm.* EXCEPT (catalog_uuid),

  -- subsection grain measures (safe — pre-aggregated at subsection_uuid)
  om.* EXCEPT (subsection_uuid),

  -- image grain measures (safe — pre-aggregated at catalog_uuid + result_uuid)
  im.* EXCEPT (result_uuid,catalog_uuid,result_dt_created,roi_id),

  -- promo grain measures (safe — pre-aggregated at catalog+subsection+price)
  pm.* EXCEPT (catalog_uuid,price_uuid)

FROM filtered_spine fs

FULL OUTER JOIN shelf_metrics sm
  ON  fs.result_uuid = sm.result_uuid
  AND fs.realogram_item_shelf_id = sm.realogram_item_shelf_id
  AND fs.result_dt_created = sm.result_dt_created

FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_metrics cm
  ON fs.catalog_uuid = cm.catalog_uuid

FULL OUTER JOIN subsection_metrics om
  ON fs.subsection_uuid = om.subsection_uuid

FULL OUTER JOIN image_metrics im
  ON  fs.catalog_uuid = im.catalog_uuid
  AND fs.result_uuid  = im.result_uuid
  AND fs.roi_id  = im.roi_id
  AND fs.result_dt_created = im.result_dt_created

FULL OUTER JOIN promo_metrics pm
  ON  fs.catalog_uuid = pm.catalog_uuid
  AND fs.price_uuid    = pm.price_uuid

columns.expression:
coalesce(MEASURE(`Adjacency Score`)*0.5 + 
MEASURE(`Average Gap Rate`)*0.2 + 
MEASURE(`Average Eye Level Images`)*0.3,0/1)

coalesce(try_divide(
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE 30>=realogram_item_shelf_id AND realogram_item_shelf_id>=0) + SUM(unknown_in_shelf) FILTER(WHERE shelf_once AND 30>=realogram_item_shelf_id AND realogram_item_shelf_id>=0),
    SUM(sku_blocks_in_shelf) FILTER(WHERE 30>=realogram_item_shelf_id AND realogram_item_shelf_id>=0) + SUM(unknown_in_shelf) FILTER(WHERE shelf_once AND 30>=realogram_item_shelf_id AND realogram_item_shelf_id>=0)
),0/1)

coalesce(try_divide(
    SUM(gap_facings_in_shelf/(gap_facings_in_shelf+unknown_facings_in_shelf+known_facings_in_shelf)) FILTER(WHERE shelf_once),
    SUM(1) FILTER(WHERE shelf_once)
),0/1)

coalesce(try_divide(
    SUM(sku_at_eye_level_in_image) FILTER(WHERE image_once),
    SUM(1) FILTER(WHERE image_once)
),0/1)

try_divide(
    SUM(try_divide(share_of_shelf,known_share_of_shelf + unknown_share_of_shelf)),
    COUNT(*)
)

try_divide(
    SUM(try_divide(facings_in_shelf,known_facings_in_shelf + unknown_facings_in_shelf)),
    COUNT(*)
)
max_by(CONCAT(' '), sku_blocks_in_shelf ) FILTER(WHERE 30>=realogram_item_shelf_id AND realogram_item_shelf_id>=0)
min_by(CONCAT(' '), sku_blocks_in_shelf ) FILTER(WHERE 30>=realogram_item_shelf_id AND realogram_item_shelf_id>=0)
max_by(CONCAT(' '), try_divide( gap_facings_in_shelf,(gap_facings_in_shelf+unknown_facings_in_shelf+known_facings_in_shelf) ) )
min_by(CONCAT(' '), try_divide( gap_facings_in_shelf,(gap_facings_in_shelf+unknown_facings_in_shelf+known_facings_in_shelf) ) )

1-max_by(
    CASE WHEN sku_blocks_in_shelf>1 THEN facings_in_shelf/known_facings_in_shelf ELSE 0 END,
    sku_blocks_in_shelf
) FILTER(WHERE 30>=realogram_item_shelf_id AND realogram_item_shelf_id>=0)

1-min_by(
    CASE WHEN sku_blocks_in_shelf>1 THEN facings_in_shelf/known_facings_in_shelf ELSE 0 END,
    sku_blocks_in_shelf
) FILTER(WHERE 30>=realogram_item_shelf_id AND realogram_item_shelf_id>=0)
SUM(distinct_facings_in_shelf) FILTER(WHERE shelf_once AND distinct_facings_in_shelf>1)/SUM(1) FILTER(WHERE shelf_once AND distinct_facings_in_shelf>1)

CASE 
WHEN distinct_facings_in_shelf<=1 THEN '<=1 sku'
WHEN distinct_facings_in_shelf<=10 THEN '<=10 skus'
ELSE '10+ skus'
END

CASE 
WHEN distinct_brands_in_shelf<=1 THEN '<=1 brand'
WHEN distinct_brands_in_shelf<=10 THEN '<=10 brands'
ELSE '10+ brands'
END
CONCAT('https://app.neurolabs.ai/task-management/',task_uuid,'/result/',result_uuid,'/validation')
SUM(1) FILTER(WHERE catalog_uuid!='Unknown' AND price_uuid!='Unknown' AND (has_promo OR quantity!=1))
SUM(1) FILTER(WHERE catalog_uuid!='Unknown' AND price_uuid!='Unknown' AND (NOT has_promo AND quantity=1))
SUM(1) FILTER(WHERE catalog_uuid!='Unknown')
MIN(price)
MAX(price)

coalesce(try_divide(
    SUM(COALESCE(promos_seen,0)) FILTER(WHERE has_promo OR quantity>1),
    SUM(COALESCE(promos_seen,0))
),0/1)
AVG(price)
MIN(try_divide(share_of_shelf,known_share_of_shelf + unknown_share_of_shelf))
CONCAT('US-',UPPER(region))
'US'

coalesce(try_divide(
SUM(try_divide(ABS((rrp*quantity) - price),(rrp*quantity))) FILTER(WHERE promo_once)
,SUM(1) FILTER(WHERE promo_once)
),0/1)

coalesce(try_divide(
SUM(1) FILTER(WHERE quantity=1 AND catalog_uuid!='Unknown' AND price_uuid!='Unknown' AND (ABS((rrp*quantity)-price)/(rrp*quantity))<0.25),
SUM(1) FILTER(WHERE quantity=1 AND catalog_uuid!='Unknown')
),0/1)

coalesce(MAX(try_divide(
    distinct_promo_weeks,
    1+CEILING(DATEDIFF(day, promo_start, promo_end) / 7)
)),0/1)

coalesce(MAX((try_divide(
    10 - days_to_median_up,
    10
) + try_divide(
    10 - days_down_from_median,
    10
))/2),0/1)

coalesce(MEASURE(`Promo Visibility %`)*0.5 + 
MEASURE(`Promo Coherence %`)*0.2 + 
MEASURE(`Promo Stability %`)*0.3,0/1)
coalesce(try_divide(SUM(known_facings_in_shelf) FILTER(WHERE shelf_once) , SUM(unknown_facings_in_shelf) FILTER(WHERE shelf_once)),0/1)
share_of_shelf/facings_in_shelf
CONCAT('',useful_image,'')
CONCAT('',uncompliant_image,'')
CONCAT('',untrusted_image,'')
price is not NULL and (promo_crop_x IS NOT NULL OR quantity>1)

CASE 
WHEN catalog_uuid!='Unknown' AND price_uuid!='Unknown' AND (has_promo OR quantity!=1)
THEN 'has Promo'
WHEN catalog_uuid!='Unknown' AND price_uuid!='Unknown'
THEN 'has Price'
ELSE 'has SKU'
END
REGEXP_EXTRACT(assortment,'^([^\\|]+)\\|',1)

FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.gold.catalog')

AND (__aibi_external_value IS NULL OR CONCAT(:catalog,'') = 'demo_production' OR __aibi_external_value IN (SELECT comment FROM system.information_schema.catalogs WHERE catalog_name LIKE CONCAT(:catalog,'')))
